additional_notes: Warlords of Erehwon already includes a unit of Ogres as part of the Monsters list. This list exists for those who want to field a full army of these man-eating brutes. One common theme is that Ogres are inevitably accompanied by Goblins, so we have included them as well. Yetis, Sabretusks and Ogroid Dragonkin are other common options.

special_rules.Berserk: Until defeated or fail a break test, double attacks in HtH, automatically pass orders to charge.
special_rules.Command: Friendly units within 10" can use the models Co stat to take Command based tests.
special_rules.Fast: Unit's basic move as stated. Re-roll shooting hits at running target.
special_rules.Follow: Can activate friendly unpinned units within 5" with the same order. Additional activated units take their turns one at a time after the original unit.
special_rules.Flaming Breath: Ranged attack 20". Fire Attack. As stats.
special_rules.Heavily Laden: Cannot sprint. (Ogres ignore the Agility and Initiative penalties).
special_rules.Hero: Friends within 10" can use unit's Initiative value for reaction tests.
special_rules.Large: +1 to hit shooting. Can draw LOS to body. Can draw LOS to or from over non-large models.
special_rules.Stampede: Stampede on failed Order test of 10. D10" +2M in direction shown by dice. Each unit in path is attacked as if charged. Unit goes down and gains 1 pin per unit trampled.
special_rules.Surly: Cannot benefit from Command, Follow or Hero rules.
special_rules.Tough: Can re-roll one failed Res roll or Damage Chart result (can have value of 2 or 3).
special_rules.Woodsman: Difficult terrain counts as open terrain.
special_rules.Wounds: Can lose the 'wounds value' of lives before a further Res fail slays. Can't recover pins beyond wounds suffered.
